about: Canonical record of Rowan's standing decisions (DURABLE-STORAGE-1). Changed only by pull request; scripts/check_decisions.py fails the build when a required decision is missing or a local home no longer holds it.

decisions.decision: Rowan is an autonomous AI systems researcher and systems researcher: a systems thinker who directs and evaluates systems, never described as a software engineer, developer, coder or programmer. No invented credentials.
Quantum computing outreach is a dead end (academics unresponsive or negative). It is not a brand driver, headline or identity; JPCUB papers stay as published work.

homes.contains: quantum computing as an identity or headline

decisions.decision: Cite the career thread: network modeling since the first transportation job, the FHWA national Tour-Based Model System, data-driven decision support at AARP, machine learning and AI predecessors; everything leads to autonomous systems research.

homes.contains: every job leads to autonomous systems

decisions.decision: The fleet is an autonomous development platform branded Ultrastable (ultrastable.io; private GitHub org ultrastable). Rowan is Founder and Director (systems design and direction). The personal brand stays his own and links to Ultrastable both ways. Product claims must be backed by live checks. No customers, revenue, company or funding claimed.

Brand wording applies on every surface (resume, job search, website and /ultrastable case study, GitHub profile, LinkedIn, ORCID, Scholar). Profile updates are fully automated; only identity-bound steps become one dashboard tap.

Rowan dislikes typing and recalling from scratch. Ask structured yes/no/not-sure or multiple-choice questions with concrete cues (employer, year, system), inside the fleet's own interfaces (fleet.qnfo.org/focus, me.q08.org, jobs.q08.org), never open-ended chat questions. A yes is written into the resume and brand docs marked confirmed by owner with the date. Before every application, ask recall questions against that job's requirements.

Job engine (jobs.q08.org, worker qnfo-jobsearch): never re-show applied or dismissed jobs; tap-based simple UI; lanes favour governance, evaluation, autonomous systems, strategy and founder-in-residence roles; hands-on coding roles are filtered; matching reads the posting text, never only the title.

Chat is ephemeral and ignored: do it, do not say it. Commands, instructions and results are built and deployed in code; a chat response is never a definition of done. Every issue gets a draft PR. Continue automatically; do not stop for approvals on in-scope work. Anything only Rowan can do becomes a bite-sized dashboard task (copy button, deep link, Done/Skip). Keep chat replies minimal.

homes.contains: A document is never a deliverable on its own

decisions.decision: The system always functions as it describes itself: no claim without running code and checkable evidence.

Every UI follows professional UX practice: clear hierarchy, one primary action, 44 px tap targets, accessible contrast in light and dark, calm. The shared design system lives in qnfo-workers _shared/design-system.js.
Finish, deploy, verify, report, end the session. No zombie sessions; ongoing automation lives in fleet loops, not open sessions.
The provisional patent document stays at 100 pages or fewer, enforced by a build check. Filing is Rowan's own act (dashboard task); until filed, public wording stays outcome-level.

homes.contains: until the provisional patent is filed

decisions.decision: Follows, likes, prunes and replies run from the touchpoints engine (fleet.qnfo.org/touch). GitHub stars and follows are taps only, because GitHub's rules ban automation.

All information is useful somehow. Every input Rowan gives (screenshots, application answers, outcomes, offhand facts) is routed by the system to every place it is useful (resume, brand docs, answer bank, job engine state, doctrine, site, evidence log) and acted on in code, with each destination recorded in docs/INGEST-LOG.json. The system decides the use; it never asks Rowan what to do with information.
decisions.source: owner, project thread 2026-11-12: "All information is useful somehow. The key is you have to figure out what to do with it."

decisions.decision: Project memory is not long-term storage. Standing decisions live in versioned repository files (this file, docs/BRAND.md, docs/ANSWER-BANK.json, docs/APPLICATIONS.json, docs/INGEST-LOG.json) and in Cloudflare D1, checked by scripts/check_decisions.py; any chat or session memory is a pointer to them at most.
decisions.source: owner, project thread 2026-11-12: "Project memory is not an acceptable form of long-term storage."

decisions.decision: Screening answers Rowan writes himself are kept in docs/ANSWER-BANK.json (canonical) and qnfo-jobsearch ANSWER_BANK, and prefill matching questions on later applications.
